summary.text: Stacie Baker is the Democratic candidate for Ohio State Senate District 3 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A member of the Reynoldsburg City Council since 2017, she works in Franklin County government.

paragraphs.text: Stacie Baker graduated from Independence High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Ohio State University in 2008 and a graduate degree from Ohio University in 2019.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has more than 15 years of experience working for Franklin County government.
She was first elected to the Reynoldsburg City Council in 2017 and re-elected in 2021 and 2025, and she said her colleagues appointed her Council Pro Tempore and chair of the Finance Committee.
Baker listed affordable housing, lower property taxes, and more funding for childcare, mental health and social services among her campaign priorities.
She also said she is passionate about funding public education and affordable health care.
